note: Reference spec written by hand for the fictitious application, following spec section 21.3.

rules.name: Only current, savings and virtual accounts can be debited
rules.statement: A payment order is only debited from a current (CTE), savings (AHO) or virtual (VIR) account; any other account type is rejected with error 50001.
rules.condition: account type not in (CTE, AHO, VIR)
rules.action: reject with 50001 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO'
scenarios:
Scenario: A credit card account cannot be debited
  Given an order to debit account type 'TCR'
  When the order is paid
  Then the payment is rejected with error 50001

rules.name: The order must exist and be pending
rules.statement: The order of the company must exist (else error 50002) and be in state P, pending (else error 50003).
rules.condition: no order for (order, company) / order state <> 'P'

rules.name: The tariff comes from the company, else from the general service tariff
rules.statement: The service tariff and whether the commission is charged separately come from the company tariff table; without a company tariff the general service tariff applies, never separate; a missing tariff counts as 0.

rules.name: Web orders pay half the tariff rounded to cents; payroll pays no commission
rules.statement: The commission is the tariff, or half the tariff rounded to 2 decimals for channel WEB; payroll (NOMINA) never pays commission.
scenarios:
Scenario: A web order pays half
  Given a tariff of 1.25 for the service
  When a WEB order is paid
  Then the commission is 0.63

rules.name: The debit includes the commission unless it is charged separately
rules.statement: The amount debited is the order value plus the commission, or only the order value when the commission is charged separately.

rules.name: Virtual accounts cannot overdraw; others may overdraw up to 100.00
rules.statement: A virtual account needs a balance at least equal to the total; other accounts may go down to -100.00; otherwise error 50004.
rules.condition: VIR and balance < total, or not VIR and balance + 100.00 < total

rules.name: A separate commission is a second debit; any failure undoes the payment
rules.statement: The payment is one transaction: the debit of the total, then, if the commission is separate and positive, a second debit of the commission; a failure of either rolls everything back (errors 50005 and 50006).

rules.name: A paid order is marked A with the processing date and the commission
rules.statement: After the debits the order moves to state A with the processing date as payment date and the commission charged; if no order row is updated the payment is rolled back with error 50007.

rules.name: Errors are reported with their code and message and returned
rules.statement: Every rejection is reported to the error log with the error number and message, and the procedure returns the error number; a successful payment returns 0 with message 'PAGO REALIZADO'.
